summary.intent: Execute phase 60 ('IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout') of the GSD workflow: 8 plans across 4 waves hardening IPNS verification fail-closed across Rust (api-client, fuse, sdk, desktop) and TypeScript (sdk-core, API service) layers.
summary.outcome: Waves 1–2 fully complete (6/8 plans, all gates green); Wave 3 plan 60-06 spawned but transcript ends before result. Wave 4 (60-08) is deferred as non-autonomous — requires human staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test.

Wave 4 (60-08) is flagged non-autonomous in the plan frontmatter: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test is a human-action checkpoint, not executable by a subagent.

code.finding: Was the last VerifyError::Legacy reference — executor had already replaced it with ::Invalid before the stale E0599 diagnostic was emitted; zero Legacy refs remain post-60-01.
Deleted entirely by 60-04; was a now-empty re-export shim after 60-01 moved the canonical verify implementation to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs.
Executor appended a stray self-check footer after the SUMMARY commit; footer claimed 'verify.rs FOUND' which became factually wrong after 60-04 deleted the file. Required manual revert.

workflow: Sequential subagent execution on the main feature branch was chosen over worktree isolation because the harness cannot reliably expose worktree branch/path manifests for merge-back — critical for a strict fail-closed crypto phase.

The gsd commit helper has a confirmed false-negative: it reports 'commit_failed / No staged files match any configured task' even when the commit lands successfully. Always verify with git log rather than trusting the helper's exit message.
Mid-edit compile error diagnostics from executors (E0599 etc.) can be stale snapshots taken before the editor flushed — always run cargo check authoritatively before treating a build failure as real.
Cargo.lock must be committed immediately after any Cargo.toml dep addition; executors that edit manifests don't reliably stage the lockfile, leaving a silent --locked CI break.
Between-wave cleanup pass is necessary: stray uncommitted artifacts (Cargo.lock drift, SUMMARY footers) from one executor can corrupt the next executor's baseline state.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative forced an extra git log verification step after every executor commit — can't trust the helper's success/failure signal.
60-01 executor emitted a stale E0599 (VerifyError::Legacy) diagnostic after completing, requiring an orchestrator-driven cargo check round-trip to confirm the build was actually green.
60-01 executor edited Cargo.toml but did not stage/commit Cargo.lock — discovered only during 60-04 cleanup, requiring an out-of-band commit by the orchestrator.
60-01-SUMMARY.md received a stray post-commit footer that was factually incorrect by the time 60-04 ran; required manual revert before proceeding.
Jest ERROR log lines in negative-path API tests buried the pass/fail summary, requiring a second targeted extraction command to confirm 159/159 pass.
Worktree isolation mode is documented in the workflow but the harness lacks a reliable merge-back path, forcing the orchestrator to fall back to sequential main-branch execution.
